summary: Official Town of Babylon history says the Town of Babylon Police Department was dissolved and merged into the Suffolk County Police Department effective January 1, 1960. Current official town materials show only limited Public Safety functions such as code enforcement, park rangers, bay constables, fire marshal, and emergency management, while Suffolk County Police states it provides all police services for the five western towns and its First Precinct covers Babylon. Within the town, Amityville clearly maintains its own village police department, but Babylon Village and Lindenhurst do not present standalone police departments and instead point residents to 911 plus local code/public-safety functions. Because NY0510200 only yields zero-count annual observations and the Babylon town control row is entirely fill-driven, the standalone town municipal control row should be dropped in favor of Suffolk County and village structure.
